D/ [CONSTANTIVS] PF AVG ; R/ [GLOR IAEXERC ITVS]

A very worn copper-alloy 4th-century Roman nummus of Constantius II, 'GLORIA EXRCITVS' second issue. Two soliders one standard on the reverse, Trier mint (335-337 AD , Reece Issue Period 17). Obverse description: Rosette diademed bust facing right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTIVS] PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers holding one standard. Reverse inscription: [GLOR IAEXERC ITVS].
